create.name: Luigi Truono
create.bio:
Luigi Truono is a sound and energy practitioner who works under the names Mindfulness Healing and Seeding Consciousness. He came to this work through years as a massage therapist, gradually treating touch itself as a way of moving energy, and he is a certified Quantum-Touch practitioner who also gives Usui Shiki Reiki. Alongside the hands-on work he guides past-life sessions in the QHHT style, in which the client brings a list of questions to explore with the help of a light trance.

Most of his sessions are built around sound. He plays crystal singing bowls, Tibetan metal bowls, gongs, tuning forks, chimes and drums, either for one person on the table or for small groups gathered for a sound bath, and he also offers smudging and space clearing with sage. Individual Reiki and crystal-bowl sessions can be booked in person or over Zoom, and he will travel to host group baths for private gatherings. His YouTube channel, Seeding Consciousness, records full-length sound baths played in a plant-filled studio, in gardens, by the sea in Delaware and in Sedona, Arizona.

courses.title: Reiki Shiki Usui 60
courses.description: An hour of hands-on energy work given in person, drawing on Usui Reiki together with the Quantum-Touch method he pairs it with on his services page. A reduced first-visit rate is also listed.

courses.title: Zoom Reiki Shiki Usui 60
courses.description: The same hour of energy work held at a distance over a Zoom video call, for clients who cannot come in person.

courses.title: Crystal Singing Bowls 60
courses.description: A one-to-one hour in which he plays a set of quartz crystal bowls around you as you rest. Ninety-minute and home-visit versions are also on his booking page.

courses.title: Zoom Crystal Singing Bowls 60
courses.description: A crystal-bowl session played live for you over Zoom, so you can lie down and listen from home.

courses.title: Tibetan Bowls 60
courses.description: An hour with hand-hammered metal Tibetan bowls, which he calls a frequency re-calibration session, played close to the body while you lie still.

courses.title: Exclusive Group Sound Bath
courses.description: A one-hour sound bath for a private group of three to eight people, using bowls, gongs and other instruments in his session space.

Only one photo: the Quantum-Touch profile picture (450x975, him seated among singing bowls before a gong). Site images are on static.wixstatic.com, which refuses us; his YouTube avatar is a logo, not him.
